QuestInfo.name: Talking Tree's Request 1
QuestInfo.0: The #bTalking Tree#k on the #bShining Forest Path in Ellinia#k has a request.
QuestInfo.1:
The Talking Tree thinks it's being ignored by passers-by because of its height. It wants you to give it a potion that can make it grow.

#i2003000##t2003000#  #b#c2003000# / 10#k


#i2003020##t2003020#  #b#c2003020# / 10#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave a potion to the Talking Tree.

0.0: Sure, it's true I can talk, but it doesn't mean I want to! People always stop to chat when they pass by, just because they're bored. It's so annoying!
0.1: They all talk down to me, no matter what I say. It's obvious, really: They look down on me because I'm so short! Maybe they'd leave me alone if I grew taller.

yes.0: Well, I won't get any taller just sitting here. All the other trees block the sun. But you humans, you're always drinking those weird potions. Those should help!
yes.1: Bring me 10 #bHealth Potions (1000)#k and 10 #bMana Potions (1000)#k. If you pour those over my soil, I'll get taller, and you pesky humans will stop hassling me all the time!
yes.2: But where do you find such potions? I hear you can't find them in shops. Maybe you know someone who can craft them. If you don't, just make them yourself! What's a little Alchemy to a human like you?

no.0: Hmph. So, you're one of THOSE people.

1.0: Do you have my potions? Please, pour, pour!

yes.0: *Gulp...gulp...* Well, is it working? Am I taller? No? But I heard they work right away... Could it be they only work on humans?
yes.1: Hm, maybe it just takes longer for trees. Thanks for trying, anyway.

item.0: Where are my potions? I hear they aren't in General Stores. Maybe only Alchemists can make them.
